system.description:
Constitution-based Paladin class built around shield-based defense and holding the line.

TypeA Constitution-based Paladin classStat BonusCon +3, Str +2Stat PenaltyDex -2, Int -1The Spartan Hoplite deals mostly with discipline, shield-based defense, and refusing to move when every reasonable instinct says otherwise. A Hoplite is strongest when protecting their allies and anchoring a battle line — elite at turning narrow corridors into very educational stabbing funnels. Their power comes from conviction and training.
Class Benefits:
Radiant Tip spell — imbue the tip of your weapon with Radiant damage
Aegis Flash spell — a flash of light erupts from your shield, disorienting nearby enemies
Shieldbash skill — slams a target with your shield, sending them backwards
Spear Brace skill — root yourself in place, using your spear to brace for impact
+3 to Shield-based skills
+3 to Spear-based skills

Class type: Fighter, Paladin
